|notes=[[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V) (Virtual Set 4)|Original 40a/40b]], [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]] and [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth) (PC Gallery Text)|PC gallery text]] each represent a complete pair. The original front and reverse are collector 40a and 40b. The December-2006 official sheet uses 40 for both. The independently archived Players Committee pair was captured 16 December 2007. Its front matches the dated later front. Its reverse says “May ▼ a marker site” without naming a phase, while the dated later reverse names the deploy phase. Ordinary site deployment rules still require the owner’s deploy phase. The One Rule separately limits a singular action when the card names a time frame. The unqualified wording can allow additional eligible separate pulls during that same deploy phase. The gallery capture does not establish its first issue or precedence.
